NOTE on overlap: children sum to 1218, which exceeds the parent total of 1106 by 112 (~10%) -- unlike the Clearance tree (where children summed slightly UNDER parent), here departments overlap (e.g. a bedding item can appear under both Chambre Literie and Decoration Textile). No 'New Collection'/'Nouvelle Collection' ambiguous marketing page was found requiring a MANUAL REVIEW flag.
